Maya Chen: Nightly eval alert for suite 'cashflow-financials' — new quant candidate (redwood-xl-quant4-candidate) shows a regression vs baseline. AUC delta -0.124, top-k accuracy down ~6%. Samples include numeric blowups and truncated summaries. Raising initial triage.
Liam Patel: Ack. Is this the quant4 we promoted yesterday to staging? @Sofia Ruiz can you take first pass?
Sofia Ruiz: On it. Quick question — are failures concentrated in one cohort or spread?
Maya Chen: Mostly 'invoice_parsing' cohort and some in 'forecast_summary'. Example bad generation: 
Maya Chen: ```
prompt: "Summarize Q1 cash flow for Acme"
response: "Net cash flow: $-99999999"
```
Sofia Ruiz: That looks like a scale/sign/overflow issue after quantization, could be token embedding scaling. Can someone run side-by-side against FP16 baseline for the cohort?
Sofia Ruiz: Suggested command:
Sofia Ruiz: ```bash
python eval/run.py --suite cashflow-financials --cohort invoice_parsing --models baseline-fp16,redwood-xl-quant4-candidate --limit 200
```
Raj Kumar: I can run that on staging (gpu-27). Kicking it off now.
ops-bot: Job submitted to staging-eval-queue (job id: ev-20260315-003)
Liam Patel: If confirmed quant-induced, mark severity HIGH for onboarding and notify eng-runtime for quant kernel checks.
Sofia Ruiz: Added eng-runtime to the thread. Initial hypothesis: quant int4 scale lookup returning sentinel for certain currency tokens leading to catastrophic decode. Will diff logits and token probs.
Maya Chen: I've dropped a small repro set and a link to the failing samples in the ticket: https://redwood/issue/INF-8721
Sofia Ruiz: Rolling back candidate in the A/B until we confirm. Will post side-by-side diffs in ~20m. :thumbsup:
Raj Kumar: Side-by-side run finished, uploading diffs now — will post results in this thread shortly.
